commands.name: asset_create_folder

commands.name: asset_delete

params: --path <string> asset or folder path, e.g. Assets/Prefabs/Player.prefab (required)

commands.name: asset_dependencies
commands.description: List what an asset depends on, direct or transitive
params: --recursive <bool> follow dependencies transitively
--path <string> asset or folder path, e.g. Assets/Prefabs/Player.prefab (required)

commands.name: asset_duplicate
commands.description: Copy an asset to a new path (new GUID)
params: --target <string> destination path (required)
--path <string> asset or folder path, e.g. Assets/Prefabs/Player.prefab (required)

commands.name: asset_find

commands.name: asset_guid
commands.description: Convert an asset path to its GUID, or a GUID back to its path

commands.name: asset_info
commands.description: Asset metadata: guid, type, importer, labels, sub-assets, dependencies

--path <string> asset or folder path, e.g. Assets/Prefabs/Player.prefab (required)

commands.name: asset_list
commands.description: List assets under a folder, optionally filtered by type and name
params: --folder <string> folder to list (default: Assets)
--type <string> Unity type filter, e.g. Prefab, Material, Texture2D, MonoScript
--name <string> name substring filter

--limit <int> max results (default: 200)

commands.name: asset_move
commands.description: Move or rename an asset, keeping its GUID and references
params: --target <string> destination path (required)
--path <string> asset or folder path, e.g. Assets/Prefabs/Player.prefab (required)

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build project (skeleton)

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Import changed files, then compile scripts (deferred)

commands.name: component_add
commands.description: Add a component to a node, optionally setting properties in the same call
params: --component <string> component type to add (required)
--properties <jobject> properties to set on the new component, e.g. {"mass":5,"useGravity":false}
--node <string> hierarchy path, e.g. Root/Body/Arm; use Name[1] to pick among same-named siblings
--id <int> Unity instance id, as an alternative to 'node'
--prefab <string> prefab asset to edit instead of a scene, e.g. Assets/P/Player.prefab
--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: component_get
commands.description: Read a component's serialized properties, in the shape component_set accepts back
params: --property <string> single property to read; omit to read them all
--depth <int> nesting levels of structs/arrays to expand (default: 2)
--maxArray <int> array elements kept before the tail is summarised (default: 64)

--component <string> component type, e.g. Rigidbody, UnityEngine.BoxCollider, TMPro.TextMeshProUGUI (required)
--index <int> which one when the node has several of this type (default: 0)
--node <string> hierarchy path, e.g. Root/Body/Arm; use Name[1] to pick among same-named siblings
--id <int> Unity instance id, as an alternative to 'node'
--prefab <string> prefab asset to edit instead of a scene, e.g. Assets/P/Player.prefab
--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: component_list
commands.description: List a node's components with their types, indices and enabled state
params: --node <string> hierarchy path, e.g. Root/Body/Arm; use Name[1] to pick among same-named siblings
--id <int> Unity instance id, as an alternative to 'node'
--prefab <string> prefab asset to edit instead of a scene, e.g. Assets/P/Player.prefab
--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: component_remove
commands.description: Remove a component from a node
params: --component <string> component type, e.g. Rigidbody, UnityEngine.BoxCollider, TMPro.TextMeshProUGUI (required)
--index <int> which one when the node has several of this type (default: 0)
--node <string> hierarchy path, e.g. Root/Body/Arm; use Name[1] to pick among same-named siblings
--id <int> Unity instance id, as an alternative to 'node'
--prefab <string> prefab asset to edit instead of a scene, e.g. Assets/P/Player.prefab
--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: component_set
commands.description: Set component properties; object references accept an asset path, guid, node path or instance id
params: --properties <jobject> properties to set; object refs accept an asset path, {"guid":..}, {"builtin":"LegacyRuntime.ttf"}, {"node":..,"component":..} or an instance id
--property <string> single property name, paired with 'value'
--value <jtoken> value for the single property named by 'property'
--component <string> component type, e.g. Rigidbody, UnityEngine.BoxCollider, TMPro.TextMeshProUGUI (required)
--index <int> which one when the node has several of this type (default: 0)
--node <string> hierarchy path, e.g. Root/Body/Arm; use Name[1] to pick among same-named siblings
--id <int> Unity instance id, as an alternative to 'node'
--prefab <string> prefab asset to edit instead of a scene, e.g. Assets/P/Player.prefab
--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: console
commands.description: Read or clear Unity Editor console logs
params: --type <string> [error|warning|log] log types to fetch
--lines <int> max entries, newest kept; identical entries are merged and counted
--clear <bool> clear the console
--stacktrace <string> [none|user|all] stacktrace verbosity

commands.name: echo
commands.description: Echo from Editor host
params: --message <string> text to echo

commands.name: exec
commands.description: Compile and execute arbitrary C# in Editor context

--usings <string[]> extra using directives
--csc <string> path to csc compiler

commands.name: gameobject_activate

--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: gameobject_create
commands.description: Create a GameObject in a scene or inside a prefab asset
params: --name <string> name of the new GameObject (required)
--parent <string> parent node path (omit for top level / prefab root)
--primitive <string> [empty|cube|sphere|capsule|cylinder|plane|quad] built-in shape to create

--rotation <jtoken> local euler angles as [x,y,z] (or [x,y,z,w] for a raw quaternion)
--scale <jtoken> local scale as [x,y,z] or a single number
--tag <string> tag to assign
--layer <string> layer name or index

--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: gameobject_duplicate
commands.description: Duplicate a GameObject, optionally under a different parent

--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: gameobject_find
commands.description: Search GameObjects by name, tag, layer, component or path

--tag <string> tag to match

--prefab <string> prefab asset to edit instead of a scene, e.g. Assets/P/Player.prefab
--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: gameobject_info
commands.description: Everything about one GameObject: transform, tag, layer, components, children, prefab linkage

--id <int> Unity instance id, as an alternative to 'node'
--prefab <string> prefab asset to edit instead of a scene, e.g. Assets/P/Player.prefab
--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: gameobject_layer
commands.description: Assign a layer to a GameObject, optionally to its whole subtree
params: --layer <string> layer name or index (required)
--recursive <bool> also apply to every descendant
--node <string> hierarchy path, e.g. Root/Body/Arm; use Name[1] to pick among same-named siblings

commands.name: gameobject_rename
commands.description: Rename a GameObject
params: --name <string> new name (required)
--node <string> hierarchy path, e.g. Root/Body/Arm; use Name[1] to pick among same-named siblings
--id <int> Unity instance id, as an alternative to 'node'

--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.description: Move a GameObject under a new parent and/or sibling index

--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: gameobject_tag
commands.description: Assign a tag to a GameObject, optionally to its whole subtree
params: --tag <string> tag to assign (must already exist — create it with tag_add) (required)
--recursive <bool> also apply to every descendant
--node <string> hierarchy path, e.g. Root/Body/Arm; use Name[1] to pick among same-named siblings
--id <int> Unity instance id, as an alternative to 'node'
--prefab <string> prefab asset to edit instead of a scene, e.g. Assets/P/Player.prefab
--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: gameobject_transform
commands.description: Set position, rotation and/or scale, in local or world space, absolute or relative
params: --position <jtoken> position as [x,y,z], {x,y,z}, or a single number
--rotation <jtoken> euler angles as [x,y,z] (or [x,y,z,w] for a raw quaternion)
--scale <jtoken> local scale as [x,y,z] or a single number

--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.description: Hierarchy dump from a node or from the scene roots
params: --depth <int> levels of children to walk; -1 for the whole subtree (default: 3)
--components <bool> list component type names on each node (default: true)
--includeInactive <bool> include inactive GameObjects (default: true)
--node <string> hierarchy path, e.g. Root/Body/Arm; use Name[1] to pick among same-named siblings

--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.description: Remove a user layer definition

commands.name: prefab_apply
commands.description: Apply a prefab instance's overrides back to its asset (all, one component, or one property)

--id <int> Unity instance id, as an alternative to 'node'

commands.name: prefab_create_empty
commands.description: Create a prefab asset from scratch without touching any scene
params: --path <string> prefab asset path to create (required)
--name <string> root GameObject name (default: the file name)
--primitive <string> [empty|cube|sphere|capsule|cylinder|plane|quad] built-in shape for the root
--components <string[]> component type names to add to the root

commands.name: prefab_create_variant
commands.description: Create a prefab variant of a base prefab

commands.name: prefab_duplicate

--path <string> prefab asset path, e.g. Assets/Prefabs/Player.prefab (required)

commands.name: prefab_edit

--ops <list`1> ops run in order, each {"command":"gameobject_create","args":{..}}; saved once if all succeed, nothing kept if one fails (required)

commands.name: prefab_info
commands.description: Prefab asset metadata: guid, type, base prefab, nested prefabs, root components

commands.name: prefab_instance_info

--scene <string> loaded scene name or path (default: active scene)

commands.name: prefab_list
commands.description: List prefab assets under a folder

commands.name: prefab_move

commands.name: prefab_stage_info
